name: Whale Coupons
description: Official hosted server for Whale Coupons, a coupon directory for independent online stores. Read-only tools find store-issued coupon and discount codes by store name, domain or product URL, search stores by product type or category, show full code details for a store, list categories, and list the largest current discounts. No sign-in or API key. Shop links returned are affiliate links.
author: Whale Coupons
